name: iterate a one-way function a tunable number of times to slow each guess
mechanism: derive the key by applying a keyed one-way function to the password and salt, then re-applying it to its own output for a chosen number of rounds (combining the round outputs); the legitimate user pays the cost once, an attacker pays it per guess, and the round count is raised as hardware gets faster

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'PBKDF2' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

fails_when: parallel hardware makes pure time cost cheap; no memory cost
